verdicts.why: A scooter/moped is the same kind of motorcycle-like vehicle shown in the photos.
A rechargeable LED spotlight/searchlight is a more specific description of the rechargeable torchlight.
A car trim/panel part is consistent with the plastic engine splash guard or under cover shown.
Bicycle correctly names the folding bicycle without contradicting the advert.
Glass tabletop correctly identifies the glass centre-table top shown.
The compact audio system matches the mini hi-fi stack, and the stated brand does not conflict with the title.
Toyota front grille and headlights match the main items shown, with no tail light visible.
The Honda Accord 2003-2007 headlight assembly matches the advert and photos.
Car engine with transmission correctly names the engine-and-gearbox assembly with wiring.
Alternator correctly identifies the car engine alternator shown.
The model says Cayenne V8, but the advert and photos specify a V6 engine.
The Yamaha PSR-550 keyboard exactly matches the advert and photos.
